description: Apache config security audit — Offline audit of an Apache httpd.conf, virtual host or .htaccess: open <Directory />, open forward proxy (ProxyRequests On), exposed server-status/server-info/balancer-manager, directory listing, weak SSLProtocol (decodes 'all -SSLv3' into TLS 1.0/1.1), weak SSLCipherSuite, SSLCompression, CORS that echoes Origin with credentials, missing HSTS/nosniff/X-Frame-Options, HTTP vhosts without HTTPS redirect, ServerTokens/ServerSignature/TraceEnable, PHP display_errors/allow_url_include, AllowOverride All, dotfile exposure. Pass text= or url=. Returns verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade, virtual hosts and findings with line numbers and fixes. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
<Directory />
  Options Indexes
  Require all granted
</Directory>
ProxyRequests On

name: security_apache_check
